purpose: Stage 4 model-free fusion engineering gate; not a production-prevalence estimate

operational_definitions.truth_scope: source-first end-to-end-v2: label raw source meaning whenever the current production extraction makes the evidence addressable; no primary-document, format, or narrative-only eligibility rule
operational_definitions.signal_coexistence: non-exclusive-v1: one grounded fact pair may validly support identifier correspondence and contradiction/equality classification at the same time
operational_definitions.literal: an explicit, non-negated local identity resolves only when exactly one collection source is defensible; references from notebooks and other non-narrative sources are equally eligible
operational_definitions.identifier: same-domain field, symbol, declared-scalar, or named derived-output concepts are correspondences; qualified namespaces remain semantic context even when leaf spelling is identical
operational_definitions.structural: native record/table containers correspond by discriminative logical field identity; record streams are record schemas, and wrapper paths do not replace logical leaf names
operational_definitions.contradiction: constant-constant-v1 only: exact unequal comparable scalar declarations with the same fully qualified concept; approximate values, derived formula outputs, profiles, ranges, equal decimals, different units/namespaces, and observations are not contradictions
operational_definitions.unresolved: an addressable local-looking reference with no unique collection target is a reported gap, including when it originates in an otherwise orphan source; ambiguous local identities are unresolved
operational_definitions.external_identity: only an explicitly external URL, DOI, absolute import, or other external identity is a non-gap merely because it is outside the collection
operational_definitions.orphan: a source is orphaned when it has no accepted positive cross-source relation; an unresolved reference is a gap and does not connect the source
operational_definitions.roles: fusion and scoring are role-independent; setting every extracted unit role to UNKNOWN must not alter any prediction

hard_negative_definitions.identifier.namespace-collision: the same eligible leaf spelling under explicit different-domain qualified namespaces is not a correspondence
hard_negative_definitions.contradiction.namespace-collision: different fully qualified namespace keys are not the same fact even when leaf spelling and scalar types match
hard_negative_definitions.contradiction.derived-vs-declared: a same-named derived formula output is not an independent scalar declaration and cannot contradict an exact declared target

scoring.gold_scope: all addressable raw-source truth under operational_definitions; signals are not mutually exclusive

disposition.post_scored_tuning: forbidden; changed implementation requires a new scored source group
